title: OpenAI websocket can leak if session update fails during connect
reasoning: connect stores the websocket on self._connection and then awaits _apply_session_update. If the session.update send fails, connect raises with self._connection still set and the websocket not closed. Callers that treat a failed connect as no active session may not call close, leaving a provider connection open and leaving subsequent calls pointed at a half-initialized session.
reproduction: Mock websockets.connect to return a connection whose send raises during _apply_session_update; await connect and observe that close was not called and self._connection remains assigned.
recommendation: Wrap the post-connect session update in try/except; on failure, close the newly opened connection, clear self._connection, then re-raise the original exception.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for connection setup failure paths, and the code has no local guard around the post-connect initialization step.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a unit test that simulates _apply_session_update/send failure after websockets.connect succeeds and asserts the connection is closed and self._connection is cleared.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/api/services/transcription/openai_realtime.py connect error cleanup plus a focused backend unit test.
